us_map.note: Lower-48 only (AK, HI and territories removed). Coordinates are in a 1440x900 design space; render inside <svg viewBox> with preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid slice'. Portal uses viewBox '0 0 1440 900' (map sits right of the 440px side panel); login uses '455 170 960 600' on wide screens and '965 110 415 898' on tall/narrow screens.

projection.inverse: see proj()/unproj() in reference/portal.dc.html (or use d3-geo with the params above)

twinkles.note: Each point: lat/lon, radius (multiply by 1.5 when drawing), CSS animation 'ofaTw <dur>s ease-in-out <delay>s infinite'; gold=fill #E3B341 else #F7F2E3; halo=add a radial-glow circle r*6 behind it.

flights.note: Ambient demo flights (login + portal backdrop). Arc = quadratic bezier bulging 18% of chord (max 70px) toward the top of the screen. Plane rides the arc with SVG <animateMotion rotate='auto'>; trail = same path with pathLength=1000, stroke-dasharray '170 3000', CSS animation ofaTail with same duration/delay. In production, swap for the client's real live trips.
